name: diff_data_sources
title: Diff Two Data Sources
description: Compares two open data sources and returns the differing regions, using ImHex's structural diffing algorithms (insert/delete-aware Myers, or a fast byte-level Simple diff). Use list_open_data_sources to get handles. Returns differences from each side's perspective.

handle_a.description: Handle of the first data source

handle_b.description: Handle of the second data source

algorithm.description: Substring of the diffing algorithm name to use (e.g. 'myers' or 'simple'). Defaults to the first registered algorithm

max_regions.description: Maximum number of difference regions to return per side (up to 100000)

differences_a.description: Differing regions from the first source's perspective

differences_b.description: Differing regions from the second source's perspective
